name: Lady Cardinal Mentorship Program
org: NC Department of Administration, Division for Women and Youth
what_you_do: Work for four weeks in a North Carolina state agency in the Raleigh area. You work next to women leaders in science, technology, engineering or math careers. You finish a group project.
grades: Grades 9 to 12 (girls; rising 9th graders cannot apply)
who_can_apply: High school girls in grades 9 to 12 who are enrolled in a North Carolina public, private, charter or home school. Rising 9th graders are not eligible. Open to girls from across the state, but all placements are in the Raleigh area.
pay_detail: $1,700 stipend, paid on the second to last day of the program. No housing is provided.
duration: 4 weeks, 40-hour weeks Monday to Friday (July 2027, exact dates not posted yet)
deadline_text: 2027 plan: applications open early Jan 2027 and close in Feb 2027 (the FAQ says the firm deadline is the end of February). Phone interviews in March, notices in April, program in July 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply when the application portal opens in early January 2027. The FAQ says to check the program website for current deadlines. Email your resume, cover letter and transcript to doa.youth.involvement@doa.nc.gov. Students who skip these documents are dropped from the process.
notes: Only 15 to 20 spots. You must get yourself to your job site every day; the program only gives rides to Wednesday and Thursday events. Contact named on the page: Jean McBride. Paid work for people under 18 in North Carolina needs a Youth Employment Certificate. See permit.html?state=nc for the exact permit and steps.
